fault_notes: The agent helps Ravi troubleshoot parental controls that are not applying to a child's device, including reviewing profile assignments and refreshing the settings. Despite walking through several steps, the agent ends the call without asking whether the controls are working or otherwise confirming that the issue has been resolved.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. You're speaking with Emily. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Emily, I'm Ravi. I've set up parental controls through my S-Net account, but they're not applying properly to my son's device. He's still able to access things I've blocked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can help you look into that, Ravi. First, could you provide your account number or the mobile number registered to your S-Net account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. For security, could you confirm the first line of your registered address and your account PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 24 Lake Road, and my PIN is 5831.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Ravi, that's verified. I'll take a look at the parental control service. Is this affecting one device or several devices in your household?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just one, my son's tablet. The controls seem to work on his phone, but the tablet still lets him open websites that should be blocked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Are you managing those settings through the S-Net app or through the website on a computer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Through the S-Net app on my phone. That's where I set the restrictions yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. When you open the app, do you see your son's tablet listed among the connected devices?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's listed there. I can see its name and the controls I've selected for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's useful. Could you tell me whether you've assigned the tablet to your son's profile, rather than leaving it under the general household profile?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I thought I had. I created a profile for him and added the tablet, but I can check again if you tell me where to look.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open the S-Net app, go to Family, and select your son's profile. There should be a section showing the devices assigned to that profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I'm there now. I can see his phone, but the tablet isn't listed under his profile. It's showing under household devices.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That could explain why the rules aren't being applied. Let's move the tablet into his profile and then review the restrictions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I've selected the tablet. There's an option to assign it to a profile, so I'll choose his name.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, select his profile and save the change. The app may take a moment to update the device assignment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Done. It's now showing under his profile. I really hope that's the missing piece, because the restrictions are there for a reason.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. Let's also check the content categories and make sure the restrictions you want are actually enabled for that profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've blocked adult websites and enabled the stricter search filter. Those are the main settings I need.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All right. Can you open each of those categories and check that the setting is switched on, not just selected in the list?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Both are switched on. The adult content restriction is enabled, and safe search is enabled too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Is there a schedule configured on the profile, such as bedtime restrictions or specific hours when access should be limited?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, there's a bedtime schedule, but the websites I'm talking about should be blocked all day. It's not just a schedule issue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Let's check the tablet's connection next. Is it connected to your S-Net home Wi-Fi, or is it using mobile data?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's connected to our home Wi-Fi. It's a tablet without a SIM card, so it only uses Wi-Fi.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying. Some changes need the device to reconnect before the new profile settings are downloaded. Could you disconnect it from Wi-Fi and reconnect?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've switched Wi-Fi off and back on. It's connected again now. I still don't understand why this wasn't automatic.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The device can occasionally retain an older configuration until it reconnects. I'll check whether the profile update has registered on our system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I've already spent quite a while on this, and I need to know that the controls are actually doing what they're supposed to do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check the profile status now. Please bear with me for a moment while I refresh the account information.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure. I just don't want to leave this call thinking it's sorted when it might not be.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've refreshed the profile information. The tablet is now associated with your son's profile, and the content restriction settings are saved on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that's what I can see in the app too. But the problem before was that the tablet ignored those settings, so I don't know if saving them is enough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The next step is to restart the tablet so it can request the updated configuration. Please close any open apps first and then restart it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right, I've closed everything and restarted it. It's taking a little while to come back on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's fine. Once it's back on, give it a minute to reconnect to Wi-Fi. The updated policy should then be available to the device.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's restarted and reconnected. I can see the Wi-Fi symbol now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Another thing we can check is whether the tablet has any private DNS or VPN setting that could route traffic around the network-level restrictions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't think there's a VPN on it. It's a basic tablet for schoolwork and videos. Where would I check the DNS setting?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open the tablet's network settings and look for Private DNS, if that option is available. If it's set to a custom provider, change it to Automatic for this test.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've found it. It's set to Automatic already, and there's no VPN listed in the settings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. That makes a custom DNS or VPN less likely to be the reason. I'll check whether there are any service notices affecting parental controls.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do. I don't want my son to have unrestricted access while we're waiting for this to work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm not seeing a current service notice for parental controls. The account settings are saved, and the device is assigned to the correct profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, but we haven't established whether the restrictions are actually being enforced. That's the part I'm concerned about.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The configuration appears correct on our side. Sometimes a device needs additional time to receive the updated policy after a profile change.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long should that take? I changed the settings yesterday, and the tablet was still accessing blocked sites this morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It normally updates shortly after the device reconnects, although timing can vary. I'll add a note that you've reassigned the tablet and restarted it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, but if it still doesn't work, I don't want to have to explain all of this again when I call back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll document the steps we've completed, including the profile assignment, the saved content categories, the Wi-Fi reconnection, and the tablet restart.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. I appreciate having the notes there, but I'm still uneasy because the restrictions were already switched on before I called.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's understandable. The profile assignment was the main discrepancy we found, so moving the tablet into the correct profile was an important step.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that seems like it could explain it. I just need to be sure the blocked websites won't open anymore, not just that the app shows the right settings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For now, I'd leave the tablet connected to your home Wi-Fi and allow some time for the policy to synchronise. If the issue continues, contact us again and we can investigate further.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So there's nothing else we can do on this call? I was hoping we'd be able to test the restrictions together.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We've completed the available account-side checks and refreshed the settings. The remaining step is to allow the device time to pick up the policy.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I'll have to keep an eye on it, then. I really don't want to discover later that the controls still aren't working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've included that concern in the notes. If you call back, the next adviser can review the existing case rather than starting from the beginning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that's helpful. I just hope the changes take effect soon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else on your S-Net account that you'd like me to explain while we're here?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything for now. I'll give the tablet some time and check the settings again later.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All right, Ravi. The notes are saved, and the account-side configuration is updated. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and enjoy the rest of your day.
